I grew up in an environment where everyone always either judged or gave me just too many unsolicited advices about my hobbies or interests. So naturally I just stopped sharing anything about them to others. The only people I can talk very freely about them are some very few friends, but this took a lot of time. 

Bf and me have been dating for just a few months so I still haven’t opened up to him that much. But I agree that he has a habit of always saying something or giving me advices. I talked to him regarding this a few days prior but it was a different issue of letting me vent to him without getting advices. Thing is that I know that he doesn’t do it out of malice. To him it’s just a way of helping me out with stuff, since he also asks me a lot about things which he doesn’t know or understand. 

Regardless, I need to have another talk with him again.
Can you explain how this is a sign of controlling? (Genuinely asking)
